mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_online_session (acct_session_id, username, username_mask, mac, nas_ip, framed_ip, vlan_id, status, start_time) VALUES (#{acctSessionId}, #{username}, #{usernameMask}, #{mac}, #{nasIp}, #{framedIp}, #{vlanId}, 1, IFNULL(#{startTime}, NOW())) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = COALESCE(VALUES(username), username), username_mask = COALESCE(VALUES(username_mask), username_mask), mac = VALUES(mac), nas_ip = COALESCE(VALUES(nas_ip), nas_ip), framed_ip = COALESCE(VALUES(framed_ip), framed_ip), vlan_id = COALESCE(VALUES(vlan_id), vlan_id), start_time = start_time, status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_online_session SET status = 0 WHERE acct_session_id = #{acctSessionId}
UPDATE sys_online_session SET status = 0 WHERE mac = #{mac} AND status = 1 AND acct_session_id <> #{acctSessionId}
UPDATE sys_online_session SET status = 0 WHERE status = 1 AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, acct_session_id, username_mask, mac, nas_ip, framed_ip, vlan_id, status, start_time, update_time FROM sys_online_session WHERE acct_session_id = #{acctSessionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, acct_session_id, start_time, update_time FROM sys_online_session WHERE mac = #{mac} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
